useful_material: The authors state that emerging evidence highlights the gut microbiota as a critical regulator potentially influencing the development and progression of ICI-associated cardiovascular toxicities, including severe conditions such as myocarditis. This study systematically analyzes the incidence, pathophysiological mechanisms, diagnostic criteria, and prognosis of major cardiovascular toxicities linked to ICIs in the context of microbiome interplay.
